description: In front of you on the table is a white plastic base with an upright post, and a separate tall white rectangular piece standing nearby. The right hand reaches to the tall piece, lifts it, and brings it over to the base while the left hand slides forward to steady the base; the right hand then presses the piece down into a slot at the front-left corner of the base, adjusting it upright as the left hand keeps the base from moving.
